title: the MM2 letter O walk - the obliviax, ogre aquatic (merrow), oliphant, ophidian, opinicus, otter and owl turns
audit_label: R809 MM2 letter O walk audit
audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTER O WALK - the obliviax, the ogre aquatic (merrow) and the oliphant on p. 96, the ophidian, the opinicus, the otter and the owl on p. 97 (the owl prose runs onto p. 98); the O-FLIP round: the Letter O gap box flips to closed (20 closed, 17 open). SEVEN .lua defs ride the R791 data_files extension, registry 699 -> 706. The OStats 7x10 grid cross-checks every armor class, hit dice, bonus, avgHp, attack, xp, xp/hp, lair, move and magic-resistance cell; the per-def doctrine pins carry the settled reads (the merrow scrags settle, the opinicus weal settle, the flat-hp and 1-1 hit-dice reads, the brute and trained variants, the loader max/sum/floor attack semantics).
include_comment: the MM2 letter O walk - the obliviax, ogre aquatic (merrow), oliphant, ophidian, opinicus, otter and owl turns

tables.name: the obliviax to owl stat grid
tables.audit_comment: THE O-GRID: the 7-row OStats stat grid (every armor class, hit-dice, bonus, avgHp, attack, xp, xp/hp, lair, move and magic-resistance cell of the seven letter O stat blocks, in print order - the obliviax through the owl)
col_comments: The armor class cells (the opinicus -2 rides an unquoted number - the R806 hollyphant -4 precedent; the ophidian "5 or better" reads 5)
The hit dice num cells (the obliviax flat-hp 1-2 read: hitDiceNum 0, the bat precedent)
The hit dice bonus cells (the otter 1-1 reads bonus -1, the bakemono precedent; the oliphant base 8+4, the trained 10+5 the parenthetical variant)
The avgHp cells (the flat-hp obliviax 1; the floor(3.5 x hd + bonus) formula: merrow 18, oliphant 32, ophidian 10, opinicus 31, otter 2, owl 3)
The attack cells (the loader semantics: the merrow "3 or 1" max read 3, the ophidian "1 and 1" sum 2, the obliviax "Nil" floor at 1)
The xp base cells (the parenthetical variants - the merrow brute IV/250 + 6/hp and the oliphant trained block - ride as consts, not grid cells)
The xp per hit point cells (the obliviax + 1/hp flat-hp read)
The in-lair percentage cells (the ophidian "See below" reads 0; the obliviax 100%; the owl 10% daylight-only roost)
The move cells (the ground move reads: the obliviax Nil 0, the merrow 6, the ophidian 9, the opinicus 21, the otter 12, the owl 1)
The magic resistance cells (every "Standard" reads 0; the opinicus 35%)
